coordinates.origin: Mid-carapace horizontal center, lowest exported surface Z0; headforward-Y, meters. Include limbs when recording bounds but not when matching carapace scale.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: Original muted natural palette; color artistic, not copied fossil mineral stains or reference pixels.

view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect cheap clay views for morphology, silhouette and attachment before final exactGLB four views.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

acceptance_obligations: Distinct animal silhouette and anatomical brief compliance in four exact-GLB views.
Portable embedded GLB, source reopening and scoped technical checks; independent review separate.
Mark GPU, world scene, user acceptance and deployment unverified until actually checked.
scope: Original static whole animal for a mid-Cretaceous marine prehistoric 3D world region. No rig, animation or scene-readiness claim.

scientific_limits.en: Colour, inflated soft volume and chosen resting/swimming pose are interpretive. No arbitrary enlarged eyes beyond source proportions; distal leg lamellae follow fossil/reconstruction evidence. Sex-neutral simplified pleon, no claim of reproductive microanatomy.

taxon.age_context: Upper Cenomanian to lower Turonian, approximately 95-90 Ma
taxon.geographic_context: Churuvita Group, Pesca, Boyaca, Colombia; additional Frontier Formation specimens in United States
anatomical_anchors: Holotype IGM p881215 carapace length8.5mm width5.2mm; primary2019paper Figs1,3,4 directly inspected.

scale.basis: Holotype published carapace dimensions, NOT total body or limb span. Record total exported dimensions separately.

pose.description: Gentle static swimming or spread-limb pose preserving two paddle pairs and two reduced rear leg pairs. No substrate, no shell carried, no extra tail fan.

morphology.obligation: Fusiform carapace distinctly longer than wide, cervical and branchiocardiac grooves and axial ridge; not a generic wide modern crab.
Very large subglobular compound eyes on short peduncles with no enclosing orbit, bifid rostrum and two small antennal pairs between eyes.
One pair P1 stout spanner-like claws, fixed finger deflected about90 degrees, paired mobile dactyl. No three-finger claw.
Exactly two large oar-like limb pairs P2 and P3, flattened distal propodus/dactylus.
Exactly two reduced narrow posterior pairs P4 and P5, subdorsal, directed back; P5 smallest. These are not paddles, pincers or shell-carrying hooks.
Readable ventral pediform third maxillipeds plus symmetrical segmented pleon with small telson, no uropods or shrimp tail fan. Simplify hidden microanatomy honestly.

concept.reason: Primary fossil plates and author reconstruction Figs1/3/4 actual pixels inspected. Original geometry, no copied meshes or reference texture pixels.

geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings only, not density targets. Spend geometry on diagnostic anatomy and continuous attachments; no hidden microdetail.

art_direction.construction: Original coherent lofts, controlled tapered appendages and readable negative space; no floating parts or mechanically stacked primitives.

world_use.role: Small active mid-Cretaceous marine swimmer in a locality-matched region
world_use.placement: Keep actual millimeter-centimeter scale. Closeup interaction can improve visibility; never enlarge source scale or claim coexistence with Cambrian assets.
world_use.integration_boundary: Static candidate only; animation, collisions, LOD and populated-scene performance untested.
